name: PrediCare - Pilotage BI
description: Vues Metabase basees sur le snapshot BI rafraichi toutes les cinq minutes.

cards.name: Factures traitees
cards.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS factures_traitees FROM mv_bi_factures

cards.name: Montant total reclame
cards.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(montant_total), 0) AS montant_reclame FROM mv_bi_factures

cards.name: Montant a risque
cards.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(montant_total) FILTER (WHERE is_alert AND decision IS NULL), 0) AS montant_a_risque FROM mv_bi_factures

cards.name: Montant economise
cards.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.montant_reclame - c.montant_calcule), 0) AS montant_economise FROM mv_bi_factures v JOIN calculs_remboursement c USING (facture_id) WHERE v.decision IN ('REJETER', 'CONFIRMER_FRAUDE', 'rejete', 'fraude_confirmee')

cards.name: Taux d'alerte
cards.sql: SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_alert) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS taux_alerte_pct FROM mv_bi_factures

cards.name: Precision operationnelle
cards.sql: SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision IN ('CONFIRMER_FRAUDE', 'fraude_confirmee')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision IS NOT NULL), 0), 0) AS precision_pct FROM mv_bi_factures WHERE is_alert

cards.name: Factures et alertes par jour
cards.sql: SELECT date_facture AS jour, COUNT(*) AS factures, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_alert) AS alertes FROM mv_bi_factures GROUP BY date_facture ORDER BY date_facture

cards.name: Distribution des scores
cards.sql: SELECT width_bucket(score, 0, 1, 10) AS tranche, COUNT(*) AS volume FROM mv_bi_factures WHERE score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tranche ORDER BY tranche

cards.name: Top prestataires a risque
cards.sql: SELECT prestataire_id, prestataire_nom, COUNT(*) AS alertes FROM mv_bi_factures WHERE is_alert GROUP BY prestataire_id, prestataire_nom ORDER BY alertes DESC LIMIT 10
